newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs - Friday estimate 110,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs - Friday estimate 110,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Friday were 110,000 head, compared with 120,000 a week ago and 99,000 a year ago, USDA said. Saturday's estimate was 20,000 head, compared with 32,000 a week ago and 39,000 a year ago.

Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts sold $0.50-$1.50 per cwt lower than midsession Thursday. Trade was moderate for light to moderate demand and moderate offerings.
Sows: generally steady to $3.00 lower US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 42.00 -44.00 43.00 -44.00

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts $0.50-$1.00 lower. Sows steady to $2.00 higher. Receipts this week 466,000, last week 406,000, last year 465,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending Dec 28, 1996 252.7 lbs compared to 252.3 lbs previous week 251.6 lbs last year.
